'''Erica Carlyle''' is an [[ally]]. She first appears in the [[Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]] expansion, and was updated in the [[The_Curse_of_the_Dark_Pharaoh_(Revised_Edition)|revised edition]]. She can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[Hibb's Roadhouse]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Combat]]
*+2 [[Spell]]

Gain a [[Retainer]] card when Erica Carlyle joins you.

==Mythos Source==
Erica Carlyle appears in the Masks of Nyarlathotep campaign for Chaosium's Call of Cthulhu role-playing game.
